title: Honor tool_choice "none" in the Ollama assistant adapter

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1065] Leave the tools out of the request when the Ollama assistant adapter gets `tool_choice: "none"`, and stop logging `tool_choice`/`parallel_tool_calls` warnings on every call for the Assistant's defaults.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1063] Send `tool_choice: "auto"` from `Langchain::Assistant` once a forced tool (`"any"` or a function name) has been called since the latest user message, so a run with a forced tool can finish instead of calling the tool until `max_turns`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1064] Send `tool_choice: "none"` as the string `"none"` from the OpenAI and Mistral AI assistant adapters instead of a function named `none`, which the APIs rejected.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1062] Return the tool calls of every streamed chunk from `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` instead of only the last chunk's, which has none, so `Langchain::Assistant` runs tools with streaming on.

@@ -20,11 +20,11 @@ def build_chat_params(
             tool_choice:,
             parallel_tool_calls:
           )
-            Langchain.logger.warn "WARNING: `parallel_tool_calls:` is not supported by Ollama currently" if parallel_tool_calls
-            Langchain.logger.warn "WARNING: `tool_choice:` is not supported by Ollama currently" if tool_choice
-
+            # Ollama has no tool_choice parameter: "none" is honored by not sending the tools,
+            # and "auto" is its default behavior. Assistant#run_tools runs one tool call at a
+            # time when parallel_tool_calls is false.
             params = {messages: messages}
-            if tools.any?
+            if tools.any? && tool_choice != "none"
               params[:tools] = build_tools(tools)
             end
             params

@@ -18,6 +18,27 @@
     end
   end
 
+  describe "#build_chat_params with tool_choice" do
+    let(:params) do
+      {
+        messages: [{role: "user", content: "Hello"}],
+        instructions: "Instructions",
+        tools: [Langchain::Tool::Calculator.new],
+        parallel_tool_calls: true
+      }
+    end
+
+    it "sends the tools for \"auto\" without logging a warning" do
+      expect(Langchain.logger).not_to receive(:warn)
+
+      expect(subject.build_chat_params(**params, tool_choice: "auto")).to include(:tools)
+    end
+
+    it "leaves the tools out for \"none\"" do
+      expect(subject.build_chat_params(**params, tool_choice: "none")).to eq(messages: [{role: "user", content: "Hello"}])
+    end
+  end
+
